news.title: Zen Technologies Approves ₹135.15 Cr Acquisition of Cogknit Semantics
news.summary: Defense technology leader Zen Technologies greenlit acquisition of 51.98% majority stake in Bengaluru-based Cogknit Semantics. Cogknit develops real-time tactical battlefield management systems that connect defense hardware with tactical AI.

news.title: Bangalore Climate Data Week Concludes with Launch of Urban Heat & Decarbonization Tools
news.summary: 5-day conclave brought together 200+ climate-tech startups, investors, and civic bodies. WRI India launched 'Data Lab Connect' and CSTEP unveiled 'BHRIGU-National + Heat Insights Explorer' for climate adaptation planning.

news.title: C-CAMP Selects 11 Bio-Startups for Climate Solutions Innovation Cohort
news.summary: C-CAMP and Ashraya Hastha Trust announced 11 biology-led startups receiving up to ₹50 Lakh each in non-dilutive grant funding, lab access, and commercialization mentoring.

news.title: Karnataka Government Proposes Mandatory GCC CSR Reinvestment Framework
news.summary: State IT & BT department drafted policy incentives linking Global Capability Center expansion in Bengaluru with local tech skill development and corporate CSR allocations.
